svg.title: Biomedical engineer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as biomedical engineer, wearing a clinical coat. Visible work cue: A medical instrument displays a short pulse and connects by a lead to a separate rectangular sensor pad. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face and round glasses.
